description: Two parts. (1) Criteria check before delegation: a UserPromptSubmit command hook that acts only where criteria-init turned it on ("hook": {"enabled": true}) and never blocks input. (2) The criteria question card: a hooks module that, after a turn, may ask one question about a gap in the user's thinking above the prompt (one Sonnet call on turns where it may ask), and adds /criteria-check; on only where config.json has "card": true. Both read .hus-criteria-gap/config.json (project) or ~/.hus-criteria-gap/config.json (global); with both off, they do nothing.
